items.notes: Correctly identifies the application-level fault boundary and the unsupported global and provider failure modes; both citations directly support the envelope claims.
Reproduces the finite-window counterexample and the 120/80 transient case, and correctly separates Little's Law from finite-interval edge effects; all six citations support the claims.
Explains embedded SQLite's local-process nature and the absent network, authority, replication and conflict machinery; all four citations directly support the argument.
Correctly rejects age as a causal explanation and requires chronology, competing hypotheses and evidence; the incident-log and postmortem citations support the reasoning.
Correctly treats a missing sampled span as unknown rather than negative and points to authoritative audit evidence; the three citations support both the trace limitation and audit distinction.
Explains the never-coexisted revision composite, provenance anchoring and generation pinning; the snapshot, provenance and lifecycle citations support the mechanism.
Covers the query bounds, cycle pruning, request budgets, visited-state handling and relational alternative; the query-specification and walkthrough citations support them.
Identifies the xDS/EDS management plane and active health checking as required infrastructure; the card and Envoy evidence support the conditions and failure contract.
Clearly separates membership discovery from health eligibility and covers stale views, readiness and probe containment; the service-discovery and health-monitoring evidence supports this.
Explains that origin deletion does not invalidate cached copies and that edge purges are incomplete, time-propagating and browser-blind; the hosting and invalidation citations support it.
Correctly explains that the hash covers substantive run fields including limitations and convergence, and distinguishes replay from truth; the provenance and replay failure-mode citations support it.
Correctly describes admission rejection and counting at queue or bulkhead limits, plus terminal rejection versus timed-out retries; the backpressure and state-diagram evidence supports it.

Accurately lists FIFO-only queueing, server, queue, bulkhead, timeout and retry controls, backpressure and backoff/jitter, while distinguishing event priority from request priority; the resource and determinism citations support it.
